test_title: SSC Stenographer 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 07 Aug, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: What is the meaning of the word "Superannuation"?

options.text: A system of retirement benefits for employees
The act of receiving a bonus
A type of insurance for future health care
The process of becoming too old to work

solution: The correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. "A system of retirement benefits for employees". [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The word **"Superannuation"** refers to a system where employees contribute to a retirement fund during their employment, ensuring financial security after retirement. (अवकाश ग्रहण) • **Example: **She decided to retire comfortably using her superannuation savings. • It is a formal arrangement to provide employees with a pension or lump sum upon retirement. (निवृत्ति लाभ) Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. "A system of retirement benefits for employees". [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Option 2: The act of receiving a bonus** (बोनस प्राप्त करने की क्रिया): This refers to an additional financial reward given to employees for their performance. • **Example:** The company gave its employees a bonus for achieving the annual sales target. • **Option 3: A type of insurance for future health care** (भविष्य की स्वास्थ्य देखभाल के लिए बीमा): This refers to health insurance policies designed to cover medical expenses in the future. • **Example:** She opted for health insurance to secure her future medical needs. • **Option 4: The process of becoming too old to work** (काम करने के लिए अत्यधिक वृद्ध होने की प्रक्रिया): This refers to aging out of the workforce due to physical or cognitive limitations. • **Example:** He retired early as he felt he was becoming too old to continue working efficiently. 16f:Tc3e, The correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. **Commend**.
